supersedes.reason: One enforced workflow, native readback truth, compact durable state and bounded verification.

intent.outcome: Users prompt once; managed work follows one enforced workflow while nine native host claims are readback-based and GUI-only checks stay owner-visible.

requirements.summary: No planner invention of scope or proof
Skills resolve once per packet generation
Approved standard MCPs are registered in each supported native host at setup; each task selects whether to call one
Nine host families have client-specific native install/readback truth
Affected verification before final full gate
Deterministic failures never become owner residuals
Release and cleanup are exact-SHA gated
OMP is a ninth native host with active-profile-safe instructions, skills, MCP and extension surface

decisions.statement: Managed runtime work uses AgentWorkflow with active routing and mandatory proof selection.
decisions.rationale: Direct, planner and pasted plans must not diverge.

decisions.statement: Native readback proves install/consumption; GUI model turns are separate owner checks.
decisions.rationale: A configuration file is not a mounted tool registry.

decisions.statement: Core projection never writes MCP configuration; normal setup invokes the separate integration registration service for the four approved providers.
decisions.rationale: Registration is explicit, preserves user entries/disable choices, and does not make every task call MCP.

decisions.statement: Artifacts are active-run compact; historical detail remains recoverable from Git.
decisions.rationale: Avoid .agent becoming larger than the product code.

decisions.statement: Native session extensions adapt official host events into the shared workflow API and never start a nested agent loop.
decisions.rationale: Host permission, cancellation, compaction and tool lifecycle remain authoritative.

tasks.objective: Admit v3 and dogfood its workflow contract.
acceptance_criteria: Active pointer names v3
Plan remains schema-valid
Runtime produces its own context/route receipts

tasks.objective: Cut managed work to one workflow and one proof/skill route.
acceptance_criteria: Pasted plans cannot skip proof routing
No fabricated planner fallback
One route receipt per packet generation
tasks.rollback: Revert only the v3 workflow commit if a compatibility regression is proven.

tasks.objective: Register the four standard MCPs through native host surfaces and fix real host/client readback.
acceptance_criteria: Core projector has zero direct MCP mutation
Setup registration is backed up and preserves user entries/disable
Grok uses $GROK_HOME/rules
DSH and Command Code use native readback
No false success after readback failure
tasks.rollback: Transaction rollback restores agent-rules-owned bytes only.

tasks.objective: Make status and artifacts live, compact and diagnosable.
acceptance_criteria: Status does not use stale generated index
Architecture map names owners and checks
No profile/mode reintroduced
tasks.rollback: Generated documentation is optional and never status truth.

tasks.objective: Run scoped gates, release exact candidate, then clean inactive branches and artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Affected checks select only changed domains
Full gate runs once at release
CI is green on pushed SHA before cleanup
tasks.rollback: Do not delete branches or historical artifacts until remote CI accepts the final SHA.

tasks.objective: Add OMP as the ninth native host without treating imported third-party configuration as OMP proof.
acceptance_criteria: Official OMP binary/version is detected
Active PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR or profile path is used consistently for install and readback
AGENTS.md and one-level skills are installed natively
OMP mcp.json uses mcpServers only through integration registration
Imported external configs never produce OMP PASS
CI matrix and terminal gate include OMP
tasks.rollback: Remove only agent-rules managed OMP block and owned skill projections; retain user profile and mcpServers.

tasks.objective: Bind official native host events to the shared workflow without nested agent execution.
acceptance_criteria: A supported native session emits a deduplicated binding with host, client, session and context generation
Pasted approved plan follows the shared proof route
Unbound Q&A creates no durable run or second agent
Unsupported extension points are reported as configuration-only
tasks.rollback: Remove only agent-rules-owned native extension/mod files.

tasks.objective: Run focused acceptance, install final candidate and release only exact-SHA evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Rules, skills, MCP registration and runtime are reported separately per host/client
Required unobserved checks cannot yield usable
Full gate and CI bind exact final SHA
GUI-only tool visibility stays an owner check
tasks.rollback: Do not delete branches or runtime history until the pushed candidate is accepted.

amendments.reason: Owner changed MCP policy from task-attached configuration to setup-time native registration, and expanded acceptance from eight to nine host families with client-specific runtime integration.

changes.change: Setup registers Context7, Codebase Memory, Playwright and Chrome DevTools; runtime selects calls once per packet.
Claims are separated by actual client, not inferred from a sibling client sharing files.
OMP requires official active-profile projection, extension load/readback and native MCP lifecycle.
